Chrothium understood that the 57e needed to be inviting and friendly, and the 57e's comms is now the 3rd most used chat in the French discord. Chrothium, you deserve this medal.

Fragging out towards the top of the leaderboard consistently without fail and is a community member like no other, assisting the French speaking community in its growth and the development of their skill. Ethan remains steadfast and active, he’s been here for the highs and lows of all of 112e’s finest commanders and continues to do it all over again for 112e. These are the rankers who have extraordinarily performed well in battles, racking up to 50+ kills.

Ethan has been here for a good while and has helped out with many small administration things such as recruiting and helping staff sometimes. Argent: Ethan has been one of the most consistently active soldiers in the regiment, and fills the role of a sappeur, scoring many kills and being a role model for newer grenadiers. He also provides regular feedback to staff, and tries to better the company and regiment as a whole.

Head of the Corsican Porte Aigles, he holds high expectations and does work without being asked, he has done this through several eras of Vistule/Corsican commanders and has done it proficiently. He does good work at his volunteer job and greatly contributes to the quality of Corsican events through training flag bearers.

As his name suggest he may have been a bit goofy at times but in recent times he has moved his persona to the first half of his name no longer distracted by sheeps but a disciplined warrior of the 57e regiment he has saved us in crucial moments and re earned his elite status Ave to Elitedumm and his reinvigoration.

Mini has been a good ranker starting from 9e, and followed me to Irish, although not the best in kills mini shows dedication when it comes to Flag guarding, not the best, but plans to improve to benefit the regiment. A good role model for rankers that try their best for their regiment.
